descriptionHtml:
Antec AX65 ARGB Gaming Case + Atom V650 650W PSU Bundle

Build your next high-performance gaming rig with the ultimate budget efficiency using the Antec AX65 ARGB Gaming Case combined with the Antec Atom V650 650W Power Supply bundle. Available at Turbo Computer, this perfectly matched hardware peripheral pair is masterfully engineered for custom PC builders, casual competitive gamers, and hardware enthusiasts across Egypt who demand massive airflow delivery, coordinated dynamic illumination dynamics, and stable daily hardware performance. This bundle stands as the definitive choice for a heavy duty, cost-effective desktop base upgrade layout configuration.

The Antec AX65 Mid-Tower features a high-airflow mesh front panel environment accompanied by a stunning 4mm tempered glass side panel to display your core build architecture. It comes fully equipped with four pre-installed 120mm ARGB fans (3 front, 1 rear) that can daisy-chain effortlessly for unified motherboard tracking management. Powering this setup is the reliable Antec Atom V650 power supply unit, delivering a continuous 650 watts of clean energy with industrial-grade CircuitShield protection tracking systems (OVP, OPP, SCP, NLO) and an optimized 120mm silent thermal management fan configuration layout.
